title: Same eyes, more worldly upbringing: each member's EfficientNet-B0 trunk carries Noisy Student weights (semi-supervised on 300M photographs with injected noise, Apache-2.0) instead of plain ImageNet weights — identical architecture, identical size
init_strategy: pretrained:tf_efficientnet_b0.ns_jft_in1k (Noisy Student, Apache-2.0, ported into torchvision's EfficientNet-B0 layout with TF-same padding)
hypothesis: On this ruler, every large step on the never-seen truedop_2024 photograph came from WHAT THE TRUNK BROUGHT WITH IT, not from what it learned from three Berlin surveys: from-scratch -> ImageNet MobileNetV3-Small 10.75% -> 49.5% usable (exp 12), MobileNetV2 86.75% (exp 16), EfficientNet-B0 92.5% (exp 19). Since then the training-procedure levers have given at most half a point (exp 20 weight averaging, 93.0% usable / 0.75% false / 6.25% abstain, mission 0.0777, kept) or lost ground (exp 22 continuous vantages 0.103, exp 23 cross-survey JS consistency 0.090, both reverted; exp 18 ring pooling flat). The three training photographs sit at 100% usable at the same held-out viewpoints, so the residual is purely the survey gap, and the invariance that closes it has so far come from pretraining. The obvious next trunk step is closed by the size gate: two EfficientNet-B0 members already weigh 31.7 MB of 33.6 MB. So this experiment changes the trunk's KNOWLEDGE without changing its SIZE: the same EfficientNet-B0 architecture, but initialised from the Noisy Student checkpoint (Xie et al., CVPR 2020: student trained on ImageNet + 300M pseudo-labelled JFT images under RandAugment, dropout and stochastic depth noise). The paper's headline finding is precisely out-of-distribution robustness beyond what in-domain accuracy predicts — large gains on ImageNet-C (corruptions: blur, noise, brightness, contrast, weather), ImageNet-P and ImageNet-A — and those corruption families are the photometric part of a survey change (exposure, colour balance, haze, sharpness), while 300M diverse photographs give a broader texture/structure prior than 1.3M. In-domain the B0 student is also ~1 point better (78.8 vs 77.7 top-1). This is 'better borrowed eyes' (exps 12/16/19, all kept) taken along the one axis the size gate leaves open: training data and noise of the pretraining, not parameter count. Nothing in this era or the 83 earlier experiments ever varied the pretraining SOURCE of a fixed architecture; every pretrained trunk has been torchvision IMAGENET1K_V1. Builds on experiment 20 (the champion) with everything else — resize, read levels, lifts, MixStyle, cosine head, committee, decode, losses, augmentation, schedule, weight averaging + BN recalibration — unchanged.
method: ONE change: the pretrained file each member's trunk is loaded from. A one-time port script converts timm's tf_efficientnet_b0.ns_jft_in1k checkpoint into torchvision's efficientnet_b0.features[0..7] key layout (verbatim tensors, shape-checked, numerically verified against timm), baked to model/pretrained/effb0ns_features7.pt. Because the TF checkpoint was trained with TensorFlow 'SAME' padding, every stride-2 convolution in the trunk (stem + the first depthwise conv of stages 2, 3, 4 and 6) pads asymmetrically (TF-same, extra row/column at bottom/right) instead of symmetrically, and the trunk's BatchNorm eps is 1e-3 (TF's). Parameter count, ONNX size (+ a few Pad nodes), read levels (112x14x14, 320x7x7), MixStyle points and everything downstream are unchanged.
expected_outcome: mission_score 0.0777 -> ~0.055-0.065 (best guess 0.06). The gain should come mostly from abstentions converting to usable fixes: usable_fix_rate 93.0% -> ~94.5-95.5%, abstain 6.25% -> ~4-5%, false_fix_rate roughly flat at 0.5-1.0% (2-4 of 400 frames). Training-capture diagnostics should stay ~100% usable. Refutation: if mission >= 0.0777 with usable <= 93%, the pretraining source of a fixed architecture is not what limits cross-survey transfer at this point and the next lever is not trunk weights. A result far worse (e.g. usable < 85%) would first be checked for a porting fault (the port's numeric check is meant to rule that out up front).
eli5: The drone's 'eyes' are a pair of image-recognition networks that were first taught on a big collection of everyday photos before we teach them Berlin. Every time we gave them better schooling, they got much better at recognising Berlin in a photograph they had never seen. We can't make the eyes bigger any more (the chip has no room), so this time we keep exactly the same eyes but swap in a version that was schooled on 300 million photos, deliberately shown blurred, noisy, re-coloured versions as it learned. That upbringing is known to make it far less thrown by changes in lighting and image quality — which is much of what changes between two aerial surveys of the same city.

stages.name: Camera frame
stages.detail: 128×128 px daytime crop, Berlin only; trained on three survey photographs, scored on a fourth it never saw

stages.name: Feature extractor
stages.detail: NEW: same shape, different upbringing. The 128 px frame is enlarged to 224 px and read by two independent copies of EfficientNet-B0, but the copies now start from the Noisy Student weights (taught on ImageNet plus 300 million extra photographs, under deliberate blur, noise and colour distortion; Apache-2.0) instead of plain ImageNet weights, with the TensorFlow-style padding those weights were trained with. Fine-tuned on Berlin at a tenth of the learning rate; each reads a 112-channel 14×14 map and a 320-channel 7×7 map, each lifted to 56 numbers and averaged over the frame into a 112-number place description; the flown weights are the average over the second half of training

stages.name: Map-cell classifier
stages.detail: each extractor's description is centred, scaled to unit length and compared by angle against one unit-length reference direction per map tile (~3,000 tiles, 128 m each); the angle match times a fixed sharpness (30) is the tile score. The two members' tile-belief maps are averaged to pick the tile

stages.name: Local belief pooling
stages.detail: gathers the averaged belief spread over the winning tile AND its 8 neighbours, and places the fix at the balance point of that local cluster instead of snapping to one tile's centre

stages.name: Within-cell offset
stages.detail: small head per member that nudges the fix from the pooled balance point to the exact spot; the two nudges are averaged

stages.name: Confidence gate
stages.detail: confidence = the SMALLER of the two members' belief on the winning tile plus its 8 neighbours — both navigators must independently back the same place; if either one spreads its belief elsewhere the drone abstains

stages.name: Training signal
stages.detail: unchanged from experiment 20: cross-survey style mixing inside the feature extractor (training only), angular-margin tile loss, offset loss, paired three-survey batches, re-photographing augmentation, pre-trained blocks at a tenth of the learning rate, 8 epochs, weight averaging over the second half with normalisation statistics re-measured

implementation_brief:
GOAL: swap ONLY the pretrained weights each member's EfficientNet-B0 trunk is initialised from: torchvision IMAGENET1K_V1 (model/pretrained/effb0_features7.pt) -> timm's Noisy Student checkpoint tf_efficientnet_b0.ns_jft_in1k (Apache-2.0), ported into torchvision's layout. Everything else in model/model.py and model/train.py stays exactly as it is.

STEP 1 — one-time port, NOT part of training. Write tools-free script model/pretrained/port_effb0_ns.py (kept in the repo for provenance; train.py must NOT import or run it). It:
 (a) downloads https://huggingface.co/timm/tf_efficientnet_b0.ns_jft_in1k/resolve/main/model.safetensors (fallback: .../resolve/main/pytorch_model.bin) with requests into a temp dir; load with safetensors (if not installed in .venv, `pip install --target /tmp/port_deps safetensors timm` and put /tmp/port_deps on sys.path INSIDE the script only — do NOT add timm or safetensors to requirements.txt and do NOT import them from model/model.py or model/train.py).
 (b) builds torchvision `efficientnet_b0(weights=None).features[:8]` with the TF-same padding + eps changes from STEP 2, and maps the timm state dict onto it. timm layout: conv_stem.weight, bn1.*; blocks.0.0 (DepthwiseSeparableConv: conv_dw, bn1, se.conv_reduce, se.conv_expand, conv_pw, bn2); blocks.{1..6}.{j} (InvertedResidual: conv_pw, bn1, conv_dw, bn2, se.conv_reduce, se.conv_expand, conv_pwl, bn3). torchvision layout: features.0.0 (conv), features.0.1 (bn); features.1.0.block = [0 dw Conv2dNormActivation(conv,bn), 1 SqueezeExcitation(fc1, fc2), 2 project(conv,bn)]; features.{2..7}.{j}.block = [0 expand(conv,bn), 1 dw(conv,bn), 2 SE(fc1, fc2), 3 project(conv,bn)]. torchvision stage i (1..7) == timm blocks[i-1], same per-stage block counts (1,2,2,3,3,4,1). The per-block tensor ORDER matches; map explicitly by name (weight, bias, running_mean, running_var, num_batches_tracked for BNs; weight+bias for SE fc1/fc2 <- conv_reduce/conv_expand), assert every tensor shape matches, assert every torchvision key is filled exactly once and every timm key of conv_stem/bn1/blocks.* is used (conv_head, bn2, classifier are excluded, as features[8] is today).
 (c) NUMERIC CHECK, mandatory: build timm.create_model('tf_efficientnet_b0.ns_jft_in1k', pretrained=False, features_only=True, out_indices=(1,2,3,4,6)) — or the plain model with forward hooks on blocks[1],blocks[2],blocks[3],blocks[4],blocks[6] — load the same checkpoint, eval mode, feed 4 random [0,1] 224x224 inputs (ImageNet-normalised identically), and assert max-abs-diff < 1e-4 (relative 1e-4) between timm and the ported torchvision trunk at the outputs of torchvision features[2],[3],[4],[5],[7] (shapes 24x56x56, 40x28x28, 80x14x14, 112x14x14, 320x7x7). Print the diffs.
 (d) saves the torchvision-layout tensors with keys prefixed 'features.' (exactly the convention effb0_features7.pt uses) to model/pretrained/effb0ns_features7.pt. Leave effb0_features7.pt on disk untouched.
 If the download or the numeric check fails, STOP and report the failure — do NOT fall back to IMAGENET1K_V1 weights, because then the experiment would silently be a re-run of the champion.

STEP 2 — model/model.py (the only behavioural edits):
 * PRETRAINED_TRUNK_PATH -> model/pretrained/effb0ns_features7.pt. Add constant TRUNK_WEIGHTS = 'tf_efficientnet_b0.ns_jft_in1k (Noisy Student, Apache-2.0)' for logging.
 * In build_pretrained_trunk(), after `efficientnet_b0(weights=None).features[:TRUNK_BLOCKS]` and BEFORE load_state_dict: (i) set eps = 1e-3 on every nn.BatchNorm2d in the trunk (TF's eps; leave momentum as is); (ii) replace every nn.Conv2d with stride 2 (the stem conv features[0][0] and the depthwise conv of the first block of stages features[2], [3], [4], [6]) by a Conv2dSame — a small subclass of nn.Conv2d defined in model.py, constructed with the same in/out/kernel/stride/groups/bias and padding=0, whose forward computes TF 'SAME' padding from the input's H, W with plain Python ints (pad_total = max((ceil(n/s)-1)*s + (k-1)*d + 1 - n, 0); pad_before = pad_total//2; pad_after = pad_total - pad_before; F.pad(x, [left, right, top, bottom])) then calls F.conv2d. It must live at the same module path so the state-dict keys are unchanged (e.g. trunk[0][0] = Conv2dSame(...); trunk[i][0].block[1][0] = Conv2dSame(...)). Stride-1 convs keep their symmetric k//2 padding (identical to TF SAME for odd kernels). At the fixed 224 px input the pads are: stem (0,1); stage2 dw k3 112->56 (0,1); stage3 dw k5 56->28 (1,2); stage4 dw k3 28->14 (0,1); stage6 dw k5 14->7 (1,2) — export traces them as constant Pad nodes. The existing load_state_dict(strict=True) and the two shape asserts stay and must pass.
 * Keep torchvision's default stochastic depth (0.2), MixStyle after features[2],[3],[4], the read levels (after features[5]: 112x14x14; after features[7]: 320x7x7), the lifts, embed_bn, prototypes, off_head, TRUNK_LR_MULT, COS_SCALE, COS_MARGIN, the committee forward(), block_mask, loss_fn, export_onnx and estimate_position exactly as they are.
 * Add a short 'NOISY STUDENT TRUNK WEIGHTS (capture-holdout era, experiment 24)' paragraph to the module docstring describing the swap, the TF-same padding and eps, the port script and its numeric check.

STEP 3 — model/train.py: no logic changes. Only update the descriptive strings so the record is truthful: the startup print line (weights name + new file), train_info 'init' -> 'pretrained:tf_efficientnet_b0.ns_jft_in1k (Noisy Student, timm/Google, Apache-2.0) ported to torchvision features[0..7] with TF-same padding, fine-tuned at 0.1x LR', the 'capture_sampling' and 'trunk' strings, and add 'trunk_weights': TRUNK_WEIGHTS (import it). Add a one-paragraph 'NOISY STUDENT WEIGHTS (experiment 24)' note to the docstring. Do not touch the optimiser groups, schedule, epochs, AUG, MixStyle, weight averaging, BN recalibration, survey_diag, chunking or targets.

SANITY before finishing: (1) a quick smoke run (`python -m model.train --area berlin --out-dir /tmp/smoke24 --epochs 1` interrupted after a few hundred steps is fine, or build_model + one forward/backward on a random batch on CPU) to confirm it builds, trains and the loss is finite; (2) export_onnx on a freshly built model and check with onnxruntime that a 1x3x128x128 input returns shape [1,3] with conf in [0,1], and that the file size is within a few KB of the champion's 31.69 MB (it must stay under 32 MiB = 33,554,432 bytes); (3) host latency should remain ~50 ms (gate 250 ms).

FIXED CONTRACTS (frozen scorer depends on them): train.py CLI unchanged — `python -m model.train --area <a> --out-dir <d> [--data-dir] [--epochs N] [--max-crops-per-bucket M] [--seed S]`, writes <out>/models/<area>.onnx and appends to <out>/train_info.json. ONNX contract: input 'frame' 1x3x128x128 float32 in [0,1] -> output 'uvc' [[u, v, conf]], u,v normalised map coords in [0,1], conf in [0,1]; the whole decode stays inside the graph. Training reads ONLY buckets(meta, 'train'); nothing under model/ may open the truedop_2024 eval capture in any form. Nothing is downloaded at train or inference time (the port is a one-time offline step whose output is the baked .pt file). Do not edit any /FROZEN file.
